UREASON FOR REFERRALU: Carrier testing for Tay Sachs disease
This individual is a member of a family in which the causative HEXA gene mutation, c.1444G>A; p.Glu482Lys has been identified (see GSTS Pathology report dated 26/07/2012).

UTEST

Test for familial mutation in the HEXA gene by DNA sequencing.

URESULTS

Heterozygous HEXA c.1444G>A; p.Glu482Lys mutation detected

USUMMARYU 

This individual is a CARRIER of Tay Sachs disease. 
UFURTHER WORK
If appropriate, other adult family members can be offered carrier testing for Tay Sachs disease.

UNotes
Nomenclature based on HEXA NCBI Reference sequence NM_000520.4, where nucleotide number 1 corresponds to the first base of the translation initiation codon.
